queries.question: What exactly causes the accepted per-floor kernel direct retry, and what state survives it?
queries.answer: The source-confirmed direct branch at GPL >84EB requires >833F=>09, a current payload byte >68/>69/>6A, and four >6B neighbors at offsets ->20,+>20,-1,+1; surrounded >67 is cleared instead. CALL >8605 consumes inline mode >01, retaining normalized >68 and bytes below >60 while resetting other >= >60 bytes to >6B without RAND. Control resumes at >8283, retaining seed, count/position sources, and base pointers while restarting >67/>6A/>69 placement and not repeating initial >68 placement. A frozen A5C3 case with only >1CEC and >1CE6 set to zero matched >84EB -> >8605 -> >8283 -> >84EB, 1,896 writes, seed >A181, and the predicted payload exactly. The separate >857B predicate remains unresolved and explicit.
